summary: Master the art of marketing with our Advanced Marketing Strategy, Analytics, and ROI Optimization Training Course. Take your career to the next level!
lede: Marketing ROI and attribution training helps professionals connect campaign activity and spending to business goals and measurable outcomes. For people who plan, measure, or defend marketing decisions, it covers setting aligned goals and KPIs, interpreting customer-journey and cross-channel attribution data, and reallocating budgets based on campaign performance. Participants also learn to build an ROI case and communicate marketing’s value to leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who design, measure, and defend marketing decisions, including:
modules: Key Metrics and KPIs in Marketing Analytics
Using Data and Analytics for Decision-Making
Budgeting and Resource Allocation for ROI
Pitfalls and Biases in Marketing ROI Measurement
